left.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Subjects who are unable to walk

right.raw_text:
-  Malignancy,
  -  Any acute medical condition,
  -  Poorly controlled diabetes  [OR] or hypertension,
  -  A motor  [OR] or sensory nerve defect,
  -  Blood clotting disease,
  -  Mental illness,
  -  Dementia,
  -  Mental retardation or other abnormal person on the organic mind

left.raw_text: -  Subjects with intra-articular solid  [OR] or hyaluronic acid injection in the past 3 months

right.raw_text:
-  Knee surgery,
  -  Knee trauma,
  -  Congenital knee deformation,
  -  Severe knee varus  [OR] or valgus deformation,
  -  Endocrine,metabolic, [OR]  infectious, [OR]  inflammatory, [OR]  secondary degenerative knee arthritis caused by problems with rheumatic immune diseases

left.raw_text: -  Subjects who are hypersensitive to needles

right.raw_text: -  Subjects who are unwilling to cooperate or sign the subject consent
